From reading to doing

What you’ll practise.

For business owners, freelancers and curious beginners who want to use AI in everyday work and learn how to check its output.

  • Give ChatGPT and Claude clear instructions, context and useful boundaries.
  • Draft customer replies, reusable briefs and source-checked comparisons.
  • Work with files, simple data analysis and image briefs.
  • Practise small coding tasks with Codex and Claude Code, then check the results.
  • Bring the skills together in a final, reviewable work pack.

Start a focused ChatGPT task.

From the Practical AI course. Try this prompt with fictional notes:

Using the fictional notes below, create a 150-word project update. Include decisions, owners, deadlines and missing information. Use only the notes. If no owner or date is stated, write “not specified.” Return a draft for review, not a sent message. Notes: [paste notes].
Finish this lesson

Take a five-line note and turn it into a useful update. Verify that every person, date and decision can be traced to the note.

The learning path

Inside the course.

42 pages, organised around practical tasks. Read in order or return to a specific lesson.

01Start with the foundations+

Choose your path, page 2. Tools, account setup, useful prompts, context, verification and safe working practices, pages 3–9.

02Use ChatGPT and Claude for useful work+

ChatGPT lessons for writing, research, files and images, pages 10–16. Claude lessons, pages 17–20. Clear handoffs between tools, page 21.

03Build and test your first small project+

Coding path with a local reading-time calculator, Codex and Claude Code, pages 22–27. Optional introduction to APIs and their costs, page 28.

04Create a repeatable work system+

Workflow and review habits, pages 29–30. Twenty-five reusable prompts to adapt, pages 31–35.

05Practise, finish and verify+

Practice plan, page 36. Final capstone, page 37. Answers and troubleshooting, page 38. Final checklist, page 39. Official-source references, pages 40–42.

A few useful answers

Know what you’re choosing.

Is this a video course?

No. These are self-paced English PDF guides. Meta has 54 pages and Practical AI has 42. Read, try the exercises and return to the sections you need.

Can I purchase and download now?

This is a checkout preview. Paid purchasing and PDF delivery are unavailable. You can read the samples, explore the outline and review a cart. Reviewing a cart does not place an order.

What is included in AED 50?

One PDF course. Advertising spend, tool subscriptions, API usage and live training are separate. Purchase terms and tax details will be available before paid checkout opens.

Do I need experience or a paid tool plan?

The guides start with the foundations. The AI course’s core method can be learned without a paid plan; some tools depend on your account, region or subscription. Meta practice requires eligible business assets and a separate ad budget.

Are these official platform courses?

No. These independent guides are created by Ascore Creative. They are not endorsed by Meta, OpenAI or Anthropic and do not promise certification, leads or sales. Interfaces and availability can change.

How can I ask a question?

Email info@ascore.ae or ask about live training on WhatsApp. Sending an enquiry is your choice.
